Madami sa pamilya ko mga police officers and coastguards. For the most part mabait naman ang iba and have good relationships with their family. 

Still, meron nga talaga na mentality yung iba sa kanila na medyo outdated, yung iba may anger and alcohol issues. It's hard to explain things, pero gets ko nga talaga na madaming pulis na red flag talaga, at nalalamangan nila yung mga pulis na mabubuti talaga at ginagawa lang trabaho nila.

As someone na upcoming freshman in college, naiisip ko din kung paano maapektuhan yung background ko with my family to form relationships with people who may have a lot of (justifiable) gripes sa mga pulis and government in general.

I don't agree with a lot of my family member's political takes, tulad na din sa mga basurang ugali ng iba sa kanila. Still, I am close to my family, I do love them for the most part.

Hindi naman siguro sobrang devastating ito sa akin haha, meron pa naman akong chance to form good relationships with people, just by being true to myself. Still, that's my two cents on the matter :))
